monsters.name: 鬧鐘小叮
monsters.line: 嗶嗶作響，快打字把我關掉！
monsters.look: A tiny round alarm clock with big cartoon eyes, bright red body, tiny metal claws, and a springy tail that wiggles when it rings.

monsters.name: 早餐麵包怪
monsters.line: 香噴噴的挑釁，打不出字我就變硬！
monsters.look: A fluffy golden-brown bread slice with a cheeky smile, butter pats as ears, and sprinkles that look like tiny stars on its surface.

monsters.name: 洗衣大魔王
monsters.line: 旋轉旋轉，打字快點把我洗走！
monsters.look: A large, bubbly washing machine with oversized eyes on the door, swirling blue water patterns, and rubbery arms that wave laundry socks.

monsters.name: 糖果小鼠
monsters.line: 快打字，別讓我吃掉你的分數！
monsters.look: A tiny round mouse with pastel pink fur, oversized ears, and a candy cane tail, big sparkling eyes and a cheeky grin.

monsters.name: 霧光蝙蝠
monsters.line: 打錯字我就噴出霧氣，你怕嗎？
monsters.look: A small bat with soft lavender wings, glowing teal eyes, and a fluffy belly; its wings flutter like cotton clouds.

monsters.name: 星辰大魔王
monsters.line: 挑戰我，輸的只能寫星星！
monsters.look: A majestic dragon-sized creature covered in midnight-blue scales dotted with tiny silver stars, crowned with a comet tail and gentle amber eyes.

monsters.name: 星塵小彈
monsters.line: 嗚呼！快打出字母，我要閃閃發亮啦！
monsters.look: Tiny spherical creature, shimmering silver with sparkling star dust speckles, tiny antennae glowing blue, cute grin and wobbling bounce.

monsters.name: 彈跳隕石鼠
monsters.line: 哎呀呀，你打錯字我就彈跳！快快快！
monsters.look: Round rock body covered in pastel purple craters, small paws, big round eyes, a tiny rocket tail that wobbles, smiling cheeks.

monsters.name: 黑洞大魔王
monsters.line: 哼！輸入錯誤，我會把你吸進無盡的空虛！
monsters.look: Large swirling vortex with a cartoonish face, deep navy core, bright orange rim, tiny star-shaped teeth, hovering with gentle aura.

monsters.name: 紙張小精靈
monsters.line: 快打字，別讓我變成紙飛機！
monsters.look: A tiny floating sheet with a bright yellow border, eyes like tiny ink drops, and a mischievous smile.

monsters.name: 粉筆怪
monsters.line: 你的鍵盤能擦掉我的粉筆痕跡嗎？
monsters.look: A short, chubby creature made of white chalk, with a crumbling body, stubby arms, and a chalk-dust halo.

monsters.name: 考試大魔王
monsters.line: 答對我才能通過，快打出正確單字！
monsters.look: A towering figure wearing a giant blackboard cape, red ink eyes, a clock for a head, and holding a massive pencil sword.
